name: Gutrot Spume
canonNotes: Lord of Tentacles and master of Nurgle's plague fleets, once a proud warrior of the Dragonbone tribe who hunted sea beasts to win the gods' notice.
Saved from a rot-kraken by Nurgle, he returned bloated, pale and with a tentacle for an arm.
voiceNotes: Arrogant, bombastic and seafaring; boasts of kills and storms.
Craves the gods' recognition more than any mortal's.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
